emails.subject: Grandma's wedding details for the archive
emails.body: For the archive: Mom and Dad were married on June 3, 1957 at St. Ambrose Church in Duluth. Her maiden name was Hazel Marie Calloway. I scanned their wedding portrait but it came out blurry — I'll redo it next weekend.

emails.subject: Found the ship manifest!
emails.body: Big find at the county historical society: Great-grandpa Elias Calloway arrived at Ellis Island on the SS Verbania in March 1921 — his name is right there on the manifest line. Also, ask Grandma about the bakery on Fremont Street next time you see her — Dad always swore it was hers.

notes.title: Interview #1 — Hazel — Duluth childhood
notes.content: Grew up on Raleigh Street in Duluth; walked down to the harbor to watch the ore boats; her father Elias worked the grain elevators after coming over from the old country.

notes.title: Interview #2 — Hazel — meeting Grandpa
notes.content: Met Frank Whitfield at a church social in 1955; he fixed her bicycle chain before he ever asked her name; they married two years later.
